items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: That's why I'm trying to figure out how did Bé Ché play, you know, during the time he used to come in.

ctx.x: How would George Bacquet play? Would he play sort of a straight, or would he play all little-

Oh no, he played straight, you know. Looks like he played straight to my remembering, you know, because there's so much changes, you know, been made for different musicians there. That's why I'm trying to figure out how did Bé Ché play, you know, during the time he used to come in. Well, I was going to ask you, how did Sidney play?
